描述_EN: beyblade began as a comic and animated series in japan. however, its popularity was relatively short lived. it is about a group of children who battle with highly powerful and enchanted spinning tops. in 2003 it became extremely popular as the beyblade series had a cult following. this launcher is an additional accessory, which can be used to improve your throwing ability in the game.
描述_ZN: Beyblade在日本以漫画和动画系列开始。 然而，它的流行是相对短暂的。 它是关于一群孩子与强大的魔法陀螺战斗的故事。 在2003年它变得非常流行，因为eyblade系列有一个崇拜者。 这个发射器是一个额外的配件，它可以用来提高你在游戏中的投掷能力。
